description: Role Summary: You will design, develop, test, and deploy scalable software systems that power core services like Google Search, Maps, or Android.Key Responsibilities: Write clean, efficient code in languages like C++, Java, Python, or Go; implement complex algorithms; and optimize data structures for high-performance distributed systems.Requirements: A Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical path, with strong problem-solving skills and knowledge of basic computer science fundamentals.

Role Summary: You will join the dedicated custom chip design team tasked with developing advanced System-on-Chips (SoCs) for Google's AI (TPUs), imaging, and cloud infrastructure.Key Responsibilities: Participate in ASIC front-end design or design verification; analyze hardware behavior; use Verilog/SystemVerilog; and optimize silicon for high performance and low power consumption.Requirements: B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in ECE, EEE, or Electrical engineering with clear knowledge of computer hardware architecture.

Role Summary: You will sift through massive datasets to uncover trends, optimize user behaviors, and help product teams make data-driven decisions.Key Responsibilities: Build automated dashboards, use SQL and Python for data mining, and translate complex metrics into simple, actionable visual reports for business stakeholders.Requirements: Proficiency in data manipulation, stats, and query building; open to any major provided you possess strong analytical aptitude

Role Summary: This rotation program allows new graduates to guide products through their entire lifecycle, blending engineering tasks with consumer-facing business logic.Key Responsibilities: Define feature roadmaps, coordinate directly between engineering and marketing teams, and monitor market indicators to refine UI/UX frameworks.Requirements: Excellent communication, a blend of business acumen and technical aptitude, and proof of leadership through previous projects or internships.

Role Summary: You will support enterprise businesses in adopting Google Cloud Platform (GCP) technologies safely and efficiently.Key Responsibilities: Trouble-shoot cloud architecture errors, debug code snippets, build solution prototypes, and consult on system administration or networking best practices.Requirements: Strong foundational knowledge of networking, operating systems, database management, and scripting languages

Role Summary: You will write scalable, high-performance code to build backend systems, developer frameworks, and features for cloud ecosystems like iCloud and Apple Services.Key Responsibilities: Design scalable system architectures; optimize APIs; write code using Java, Python, C++, or Go; and maintain secure infrastructure handling millions of concurrent operations.Requirements: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field, strong data structures and algorithms (DSA) fundamentals, and a deep understanding of object-oriented programming.

Role Summary: You will work on pre-silicon verification, ensuring that the custom chip architectures power Apple's devices meet rigorous performance and functionality standards.Key Responsibilities: Create testbenches; write automated verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM; and locate, debug, and document logical errors in complex ASIC or SoC designs.Requirements: B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in ECE, EEE, or Microelectronics, with strong familiarity in digital design principles and hardware description languages.

Role Summary: You will design, train, and deploy advanced ML models that enhance intelligent user experiences across products like Siri, camera tech, and proactive features.
Key Responsibilities: Implement machine learning algorithms, process large datasets, optimize models to run efficiently on Apple devices (CoreML), and write code in Python, C++, or Swift.
Requirements: Degree in CS, Data Science, or related quantitative disciplines, with practical knowledge of frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Role Summary: You will join Apple's global supply chain engine to manage procurement, logistics, product quality, or manufacturing scale-up for retail and hardware streams.
Key Responsibilities: Analyze vendor capacities; build demand forecasting models using SQL and Excel; audit factory efficiency; and collaborate across global teams to deliver products on schedule.
Requirements: Degree in Engineering (Mechanical/Industrial preferred) or Business/Supply Chain, with top-tier analytical thinking and spreadsheet modeling capabilities.

Role Summary: You will write clean code to build and refine core application features that interface directly with the Apple device ecosystem.
Key Responsibilities: Develop fluid, responsive user interfaces; integrate native frameworks and device sensors; write robust code in Swift and Objective-C; and profile applications for smooth performance.
Requirements: Bachelor's degree in a technical stream, a portfolio of personal mobile apps or open-source contributions, and familiarity with Apple development platforms (Xcode).

Role Summary: You will write scalable code to develop and maintain core Microsoft products, operating systems, and platforms like Azure, Windows, Office 365, and Xbox.Key Responsibilities: Build software components using C++, C#, Java, or Python; implement complex algorithms; design secure REST APIs; and debug cloud infrastructure workflows.Requirements: A Bachelor’s or Master’s engineering degree in a technical stream, strong Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) proficiency, and solid object-oriented programming skills.

Role Summary: You will sit at the intersection of coding and research to build sophisticated machine learning algorithms that drive features in Microsoft Copilot, Bing, and Azure AI.
Key Responsibilities: Train generative AI and deep learning models; process massive unstructured data pipelines; conduct structural mathematical modeling; and execute A/B testing frameworks.
Requirements: B.Tech/M.Tech/MS in Computer Science, Data Science, Math, or Stats. Proficiency with Python, R, PyTorch, or Azure ML tools is preferred.

Role Summary: You will work directly with enterprise businesses deploying applications onto Microsoft Azure, troubleshooting deployment roadmaps, and providing technical support. 

Microsoft Careers
 +1
Key Responsibilities: Diagnose complex networking, security, or database bottlenecks on Azure; deploy hybrid cloud migrations; and write automation scripts to streamline customer infrastructure. 
Requirements: Strong foundational knowledge of OS (Windows/Linux), computer networks, SQL databases, and general cloud computing frameworks.

Role Summary: You will act as the bridge between engineering, design, and business teams to define the vision, features, and user journeys for Microsoft tools.
Key Responsibilities: Conduct market intelligence audits, write detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), track feature usage telemetry, and prioritize engineering roadmaps.
Requirements: Strong leadership qualities, crisp cross-functional communication, and a clear analytical mindset to evaluate product trade-offs.

Role Summary: You will support the foundation of Microsoft's cloud infrastructure by handling the deployment, diagnosis, and structural maintenance of physical servers.
Key Responsibilities: Replace failing blades, components, and network switches; run diagnostic checks on physical servers; manage infrastructure fiber routing; and handle inventory asset tracking.
Requirements: Engineering degree or polytechnic diploma in EEE, ECE, or IT, along with basic troubleshooting skills for computer hardware and server infrastructure.
